Container.Name: printlog-bridge
Container.Overview: Logs every print from your Klipper printers to 3D Print Log (3dprintlog.com) automatically. One container watches every printer listed in printlog-bridge.cfg in the data folder, over each printer's Moonraker WebSocket. Write that config and store your API key before you start it: see the project's README, "On Unraid".
Container.Requires: A printlog-bridge.cfg in the data folder, and an API key from https://www.3dprintlog.com/api-keys

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Holds printlog-bridge.cfg (which you write) and state/ (the outbox, the key file, the log and the support bundle). It must belong to nobody:users (99:100), the user the container runs as.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional. Leave it empty to use the key stored in the data folder with store-key (README). A key here is visible to anyone who can edit this container.
